headline: Worst drop for BMV and BIVA since March
summary: The IPC fell 3.62% over the week and the FTSE-BIVA lost 3.22%, their weakest weekly result since March 6.
why: The IPC is the benchmark index of the Mexican Stock Exchange, and its performance reflects investor sentiment toward Mexican equities.
why_moved: Broad weekly losses across the index pushed Mexico's benchmark to its weakest result since early March.
original_headline: Peor caída para la BMV y BIVA desde marzo
